bugs.criterion: JRN-79 + JRN-89 Project banners and photos
bugs.title: Edit project -> Save fails with 409 conflict after you change photos in the same dialog
bugs.evidence: On QA Photo Test (QAPT) in Edit project -> Photos I added 2 images, reordered them (Move left) and starred a cover. Each change saved to the backend right away (GET /api/projects shows QAPT cover_photo_id updated). Then I clicked project-save and the dialog showed a 409 conflict error and stayed open (screenshot p3-project-banners-photos-failure.png). The likely cause is that each photo change bumps the project version, so the form submits an old version. Separate issue: if you close the dialog with Escape instead, the project page hero keeps the old cover until you reload (seen in an earlier run). The non-image file was refused correctly with 'Photo must be an image under 15 MB'.

bugs.title: On a 390 phone, a report opens scrolled down instead of at the top
bugs.evidence: At 390, tapping hub-tile-outstanding-v2 opens the report with window.scrollY=1529. The screenshot shows table cards in the middle of the report, and the sheet header and '‹ all reports' are off screen. It failed the same way on rerun, so it is not flaky. The API works (outstanding-v2 returns 200 and the tile shows ₹7.43 Cr).

action_items.detail: Shalini Thakur's customer page says 'Next due: Nothing due — all bills settled' while the same page shows ₹6.4 L due (unpaid other charges). The Record payment form for her shows 'Can accept up to ₹0' with Other charges ₹6.4 L (checked before choosing a Mode).

One customer card status reads 'DUE NOW', which is not in the specified set (OVERDUE N DAYS / DUE ON / ADVANCE HELD / NEXT ·). The segment chip is labelled 'needs attention', not 'overdue'. The chips still add up: 12+65+1+0+2 = 80 = All.
Record payment shows Booking, Amount, Date, Mode plus a Remarks field. Bank account did not show before a Mode was chosen, so the 5-field rule is unclear.

The empty search result on Receipts says 'No receipts. Post the first payment to see it here.' 'Post' does not match the 'Record payment' wording, and 'first payment' is misleading when the list is only filtered.

The Leads & Visits header is a tagline, not a numbers summary, and has several primary actions (Book visit / New lead / Add / Do next). Leads shows 'Follow-ups due 0' while Admin Home shows '1 follow-ups due'.
The Sales Home inventory widget says '79 of 186 booked or sold' and Admin Home says '78 of 186'.
The Project Statement tile caption 'pick one for its full statement' does not end with this FY / till today / today.
Not exercised: opening the Outstanding report from Home's 90+ band to see 'ageing band 90+ days' in the header.

I created the project 'QA Photo Test' (QAPT, id 823ceb0a-b48b-4f78-a478-2d22b0c4920b) through the API for the photo test, and its test photos were deleted afterwards. It now shows on /projects and in the report project filters. The admin theme was switched during the theme test and put back to Day. SGH and Ye were not edited.
